prompt:
Files: utilization.csv (per-instance p95 CPU and memory utilization) and instance_catalog.csv (instance types with vcpu, memory_gib, hourly_usd). Rightsizing rule: for each instance, required_vcpu = current_vcpu * p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7 and required_mem = current_memory_gib * p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8. The recommended type is the cheapest instance_type in the SAME family (from instance_catalog.csv) with vcpu >= required_vcpu and memory_gib >= required_mem. If no type in the family satisfies both, keep the current type. Monthly cost = hourly_usd * 730. If every instance is moved to its recommended type, what is the net total monthly saving in USD (positive = saving; upsizes count as negative savings)? Round to 2 decimals.

Data files in your working directory: utilization.csv, instance_catalog.csv.

Required final answer format (JSON inside <answer></answer> tags):
{"monthly_saving": <number>}

import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
m = u.merge(c, on='instance_type', suffixes=('','_cur'))
m['req_vcpu'] = m['vcpu_cur']*m['p95_cpu_pct']/100/0.7
m['req_mem'] = m['memory_gib_cur']*m['p95_mem_pct']/100/0.8
total = 0.0
for _, r in m.iterrows():
    fam = c[(c.family==r.family) & (c.vcpu>=r.req_vcpu) & (c.memory_gib>=r.req_mem)]
    if len(fam):
        rec = fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0]
    else:
        rec = c[c.instance_type==r.instance_type].iloc[0]
    saving = (r.hourly_usd_cur - rec.hourly_usd)*730
    total += saving
    print(r.instance_id, r.instance_type, '->', rec.instance_type, round(saving,2))
print('TOTAL', round(total,2))

import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv').rename(columns={'vcpu':'vcpu_cur','memory_gib':'mem_cur','hourly_usd':'hr_cur'})
m = u.merge(c, on='instance_type')
c2 = c[['instance_type','family','vcpu_cur','mem_cur','hr_cur']].rename(columns={'vcpu_cur':'vcpu','mem_cur':'memory_gib','hr_cur':'hourly_usd'})
m['req_vcpu'] = m['vcpu_cur']*m['p95_cpu_pct']/100/0.7
m['req_mem'] = m['mem_cur']*m['p95_mem_pct']/100/0.8
total = 0.0
for _, r in m.iterrows():
    fam = c2[(c2.family==r.family) & (c2.vcpu>=r.req_vcpu) & (c2.memory_gib>=r.req_mem)]
    rec = fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0] if len(fam) else c2[c2.instance_type==r.instance_type].iloc[0]
    total += (r.hr_cur - rec.hourly_usd)*730
print(repr(total), round(total,2))

import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv').rename(columns={'vcpu':'vcpu_cur','memory_gib':'mem_cur','hourly_usd':'hr_cur'})
m = u.merge(c, on='instance_type')
c2 = c[['instance_type','family','vcpu_cur','mem_cur','hr_cur']].rename(columns={'vcpu_cur':'vcpu','mem_cur':'memory_gib','hr_cur':'hourly_usd'})
m['req_vcpu'] = m['vcpu_cur']*m['p95_cpu_pct']/100/0.7
m['req_mem'] = m['mem_cur']*m['p95_mem_pct']/100/0.8
total = 0.0
for _, r in m.iterrows():
    fam = c2[(c2.family==r.family) & (c2.vcpu>=r.req_vcpu) & (c2.memory_gib>=r.req_mem)]
    rec = fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0] if len(fam) else c2[c2.instance_type==r.instance_type].iloc[0]
    total += (r.hr_cur - rec.hourly_usd)*730
print(repr(total), round(total,2))

{"code": "import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv').rename(columns={'vcpu':'vcpu_cur','memory_gib':'mem_cur','hourly_usd':'hr_cur'})
m = u.merge(c, on='instance_type')
c2 = c[['instance_type','family','vcpu_cur','mem_cur','hr_cur']].rename(columns={'vcpu_cur':'vcpu','mem_cur':'memory_gib','hr_cur':'hourly_usd'})
m['req_vcpu'] = m['vcpu_cur']*m['p95_cpu_pct']/100/0.7
m['req_mem'] = m['mem_cur']*m['p95_mem_pct']/100/0.8
total = 0.0
for _, r in m.iterrows():
    fam = c2[(c2.family==r.family) & (c2.vcpu>=r.req_vcpu) & (c2.memory_gib>=r.req_mem)]
    rec = fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0] if len(fam) else c2[c2.instance_type==r.instance_type].iloc[0]
    total += (r.hr_cur - rec.hourly_usd)*730
print(repr(total), round(total,2))"}
